authority: Project owner delegated executable Michael SMARTS and PAINS choices to the agent on 2026-07-29.
scope: Conservative, high-precision structural primary screen. It is a reproducible structural alert screen, not a prediction of measured covalent reactivity.

input_handling.structure_representation: Use P1-02 canonical SMILES as supplied.
input_handling.salt_fragment_policy: Do not strip salts or select a parent fragment. Multi-fragment records remain needs_review.
input_handling.tautomer_policy: No tautomer canonicalization beyond the existing P1-02 canonical SMILES.
input_handling.stereochemistry_policy: Do not erase or infer stereochemistry.

lipinski.comparison: A value equal to its threshold passes; only values greater than the threshold fail.

michael_acceptor.decision_rule: A single-fragment Lipinski-pass structure is Michael-positive when it matches one or more of the four strict structural rules below.
michael_acceptor.matching: RDKit substructure matching on the input canonical SMILES; useChirality=False.

rules.label: alpha,beta-unsaturated carbonyl
rules.rationale: Requires the O=C-C=C conjugation path; it does not label a saturated carbonyl as a Michael acceptor.

rules.label: conjugated lactone
rules.rationale: A strict lactone rule: the ester oxygen-to-acyl-carbon bond is a ring bond and the lactone is alpha,beta-unsaturated. Saturated lactones are deliberately not called Michael acceptors.

rules.label: nitroalkene
rules.rationale: Requires a normal charged nitro group directly attached to a vinylic carbon; nitroalkanes and nitroarenes do not match.

rules.label: carbocyclic ortho- or para-quinone
rules.rationale: Requires a non-aromatic six-membered carbocyclic o- or p-quinone core. Quinone methides, heteroquinones and semiquinones are not included in this conservative definition.

pains.catalog: PAINS (the RDKit union of PAINS_A, PAINS_B and PAINS_C)
pains.decision_rule: Any PAINS catalog match flags the structure and excludes it from the strict primary-candidate output. The audit output preserves every matched description for later expert review.
pains.application_order: Apply only after a structure has passed Lipinski and matched a strict Michael rule; this is logically equivalent for strict-pass selection and avoids needless computation on ineligible structures.

status_definitions.pass_primary_filter: single fragment, passes all four Lipinski thresholds, matches at least one strict Michael rule, and has no PAINS match
status_definitions.fail_lipinski: single fragment with one or more fixed-threshold Lipinski failures
status_definitions.fail_michael: single fragment that passes Lipinski but matches no strict Michael rule
status_definitions.fail_pains: single fragment that passes Lipinski and matches Michael but has one or more PAINS matches
status_definitions.needs_review: multi-fragment or unreparseable structure; no parent-fragment choice is made
